text: A worker entered a confined space without gas testing, without a permit, and without an attendant. The atmosphere was not verified before entry.
The confined-space permit was approved, the atmosphere was tested and confirmed safe, continuous monitoring was active, an attendant was present, and the rescue team was ready before entry.
A worker removed a jam from a running machine without isolating the energy source or applying LOTO. The machine unexpectedly started while the worker was reaching into the moving mechanism.
The machine was stopped, all energy sources were isolated and locked out, zero energy was verified, and the jam was removed using the approved procedure.
A worker climbed to an elevated work area without a harness or lanyard and worked near an unprotected edge.
The worker used the approved access system, wore the required harness and lanyard, and connected the fall-arrest system before working at height.
An employee bypassed a machine interlock and operated the equipment with the safety control defeated.
The machine interlock was functional, remained enabled, and the equipment was operated only after the safety control was verified.
A suspended load swung unexpectedly during crane lifting and passed close to a worker. The worker was not struck and no injury occurred.
The lifting area was barricaded, the exclusion zone was maintained, the load was controlled by the signalman, and no personnel entered beneath or near the suspended load.
A hydraulic hose suddenly whipped during equipment operation and passed close to a worker, who moved away before being struck.
The hydraulic hose was inspected, secured correctly, and the work area was kept clear before equipment operation resumed.
A tool fell from an elevated platform and landed close to a worker below. No one was injured.
Tools were secured with approved tethers, the exclusion zone below the work area was established, and no unauthorized person entered the drop zone.
A vehicle nearly struck a pedestrian at an operating site intersection because the pedestrian and vehicle entered the same path at the same time.
Vehicle and pedestrian routes were segregated, the crossing was controlled, and the driver stopped at the designated crossing before proceeding.
A damaged electrical cable has exposed conductors near a wet work area. The cable insulation is broken and the exposed section has not been isolated or repaired.
The damaged electrical cable was removed from service, the circuit was isolated and locked out, the area was made safe, and the cable was replaced by an authorized electrician before work resumed.
A high-pressure process line has severe corrosion and pitting around a flange, with visible leakage developing from the joint. The damaged section has not yet been repaired.
The leaking section was isolated, depressurized, repaired, pressure-tested, and returned to service only after the repair was verified.
A scaffold has a damaged support member and missing guardrails, creating an unstable and unprotected work platform.
The damaged scaffold was removed from service, the structure was repaired and inspected, and all required guardrails were installed before the scaffold was used again.
A slippery oil spill is present on an active walkway near operating equipment and has not yet been cleaned or barricaded.
The oil spill was contained and cleaned, the area was barricaded during cleanup, and the walkway was reopened only after the surface was made safe.
A worker entered an oxygen-deficient confined space without gas testing or an approved permit. No attendant or rescue team was available.

A worker entered the confined space only after the permit was approved, the atmosphere was tested and confirmed safe, continuous gas monitoring was active, an attendant was stationed outside, and a rescue team was available.

A worker entered a process vessel without confirming atmospheric conditions and without isolating the connected energy sources. The worker started work inside the vessel before the required confined-space controls were established.

Before entry into the process vessel, all connected energy sources were isolated and locked out, the vessel was made safe, the atmosphere was tested, continuous monitoring was established, and an approved confined-space permit was issued.

A worker attempted to enter a confined space without a permit, without continuous gas monitoring, and without a retrieval or rescue plan. Another worker entered behind him to assist without proper controls.

Confined-space entry was performed under an approved permit with atmospheric testing, continuous gas monitoring, an attendant, a retrieval system, and a documented rescue plan with trained responders.
A suspended pipe section swung unexpectedly during a crane lift and passed close to a worker who was standing inside the lifting area. The worker moved away before being struck.
A crane lift of a pipe section was carried out inside a barricaded exclusion zone. A trained rigger controlled the load with tag lines and workers remained outside the lifting area.
A suspended load shifted suddenly while being lifted and moved toward two workers. The workers stepped back just before the load passed close to them.
The suspended load was inspected before lifting, secured correctly, controlled with tag lines, and lifted only after the exclusion zone was established and all personnel were clear.
A crane load swung across a walkway and nearly struck a worker who was walking nearby. The worker stopped and moved clear before contact occurred.
The crane lifting path was planned in advance, the walkway was isolated with barricades, and a spotter ensured that no person entered the lifting area while the load was suspended.
A high-pressure hydraulic hose failed during equipment operation and began whipping near a maintenance worker. The worker moved away before being hit.
The hydraulic system was isolated and depressurized before maintenance. The damaged hose was replaced, pressure was checked, and the equipment was returned to service after verification.
A hydraulic line ruptured unexpectedly and the pressurized hose whipped toward the operator. The operator stepped clear and avoided contact.
Before work began, the hydraulic equipment was stopped, energy was isolated, hydraulic pressure was fully released, and the defective line was replaced using the approved procedure.
A leaking hydraulic hose moved violently when pressure changed and came close to a worker performing inspection. The worker withdrew before being struck.
The hydraulic circuit was isolated and bled to zero pressure before inspection. The defective hose was repaired by authorized personnel and the system was tested safely before operation.
A damaged electrical cable has exposed conductors near a wet work area. The cable insulation is broken and the exposed section has not been isolated or repaired.
The damaged electrical cable was removed from service, the circuit was isolated and locked out, the area was made safe, and the cable was replaced by an authorized electrician before work resumed.
An electrical junction box has an open cover with exposed live terminals in an accessible work area. The electrical circuit has not been isolated and the hazard remains present.
The electrical circuit was isolated and locked out, zero energy was verified, the junction box cover was repaired by an authorized electrician, and the area was made safe before work resumed.
A frayed extension cable has exposed wires on a construction worksite. The damaged cable remains in service and has not been removed from use.
The damaged extension cable was removed from service, the electrical supply was isolated, the defective cable was replaced, and the area was checked by authorized personnel before work resumed.
A high-pressure process line has severe corrosion and pitting around a flange, with visible leakage developing from the joint. The damaged section has not yet been repaired.
The leaking process section was isolated, depressurized, repaired, pressure-tested, and returned to service only after the repair was verified.
A pressurized process pipe has significant external corrosion and a developing crack near a flange. The line remains in service and the damaged section has not been repaired.
The affected process pipe was isolated and depressurized, the damaged section was repaired, the repair was pressure-tested, and the line was returned to service after verification.
A corroded high-pressure line near the pump shows wall thinning and leakage. The condition has not been repaired and the line remains under operating pressure.

The affected high-pressure line was removed from service through proper isolation, pressure was released, the damaged section was repaired and inspected, and the line was returned to service after successful testing.
A scaffold has a missing guardrail and an unsecured platform plank at an elevated work area. The scaffold remains available for workers to use.
The scaffold was taken out of service, missing guardrails were installed, the platform was secured, and the scaffold was inspected and approved before workers returned.
An elevated scaffold platform has an incomplete working deck and missing toe boards. Materials could fall from the platform and workers could be exposed to a fall hazard.
The scaffold was barricaded and removed from service until the platform was completed, toe boards were installed, and a competent person inspected and approved the scaffold.
A scaffold has a loose plank and damaged access ladder, and its inspection status is not current. Workers are still using the scaffold.
The scaffold was taken out of service, the loose plank and damaged ladder were replaced, the scaffold was inspected by a competent person, and the updated inspection status was displayed before use.

Helper entered mud tank to clean it without gas testing and no standby person outside
Rigger stood directly under suspended drill collar while crane was lifting it
Derrickman climbed to monkey board at 25 m without full-body harness

Worker stood in front of pressurised hose connection during pressure test, hose whipped and missed him by a metre
Contractor drove pickup inside field at high speed while using mobile phone, no seatbelt
Maintenance crew started pump overhaul without a valid work permit
Worker almost slipped on oil spill near maintenance area, no injury
Water cooler in canteen not working
Office staff not wearing ID card inside admin building
